---
name: New Watch Driver Request
about: Request or propose support for a new smartwatch model
title: '[DRIVER] '
labels: new-watch-driver
assignees: ''
---

**Watch Details**
- Brand: [e.g. Noise, boAt, Amazfit]
- Model: [e.g. ColorFit Pro 4]
- Official App (if any): [e.g. NoiseFit / Da Fit]

**BLE Research Done**
What have you already discovered? (Services, characteristics, any packets observed in nRF Connect)

**Service UUIDs Found**
List any discovered service UUIDs.

**Characteristic UUIDs Found**
List any discovered characteristic UUIDs and their properties (Read, Write, Notify, etc.)

**Sample Packets**
If you captured any raw packets, paste them here:

```
07 XX 00 00 XX 00 00 XX XX 00
```

**Official App Availability**
Is the official app still available? Are you trying to reverse-engineer it or rely purely on BLE sniffing?

**Willingness to Contribute**
Are you willing to write and submit the driver code yourself, or just requesting community support?
